text: {"lessons":["I sold several positions at gains, but that alone does not mean the sales improved my overall results; I should judge each trade by whether it fits my portfolio plan.","My average cost is not a reason to hold a losing position or sell a winning one; I should base decisions on current risk and expected return, not the comfort of avoiding a realized loss or locking in a gain.","Past price moves do not predict future moves, so I should avoid reacting to short-term account fluctuations and review my diversified portfolio deliberately, even if I trade infrequently."]}
